synopsis: The booklet presents AWS G6e as a generic, pay-per-use GPU cloud execution option using NVIDIA L40S GPUs, alongside Google Cloud G2 with NVIDIA L4 GPUs [f8370, f9257, f16202]. G6e instances offer up to eight L40S GPUs with 48 GB each, up to 192 vCPUs, 1.536 TB of RAM and 400 Gbps networking [f8854]. The listed 2026 public on-demand price range is USD 1.861–30.131 per hour in us-east-1, based on trackers [f9258]. Although included among cloud execution options, the tools table marks its off-road relevance as not applicable, rather than establishing an off-road-specific role [f8370, f9257].

relations.note: Both identify G6e with L40S and Google Cloud G2 with L4.
